title: Momotarou Douchuuki
overview:
King Bombie's ancestor appears! His name is none other than Bombie Daimaou!

Set in the Edo period. Packed with fun events.

The area has expanded too. A journey on foot across the whole country.
Newly added are "Kunashiri," "Etorofu," "Karafuto," "Taiwan" and "Tsushima," expanding the area. What's more, unexpected places such as "Ryuuguu-jou" and "Onigashima" have been added.

Voices and sound are rich too!

キングボンビーのご先祖様登場！その名もなんとボンビー大魔王

舞台は江戸時代。おもしろイベント目白押し。

エリアも拡大。全国行脚の旅でござる。
新たに、「国後」「択捉」「樺太」「台湾」「対馬」が加わりエリア拡大。なんと「竜宮城」「鬼が島」など意外な場所も追加されました。

音声＆サウンドも充実！
